title: Honda joins forces with Redwire to develop robots for commercial space stations
summary: Honda joins forces with Redwire to develop robots for commercial space stations
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO – Honda announced plans Oct. 1 to work with Redwire to develop robots to assist commercial space station crews.
